title: ceammc.flt
description: `ceammc.flt` is an index of filtering objects in the ceammc library, covering audio filters, equalizers, filterbanks, coefficient calculators, and frequency-response tools. Use the listed `flt.*` objects, such as `flt.lpf12~` for a second-order Butterworth low-pass filter or `flt.median` for control-flow median filtering, according to the required filtering task.
